name: eaveswatch
description: Review a whole system from its eaves: logs, deploys and connections from every host, joined to the code that made them. Targeted findings, each traceable to its evidence.

config.about: the eaveswatch config file this ridge uses (its "ridge": {"data": ...} folder is where the digests, map and findings live)

data.about: the ridge's data folder (the same as "ridge": {"data"} in that config): the agent may write here (findings, asks, REVIEW.md)

repos.about: where the code lives on this box (folders of git checkouts, space-separated), to read the code behind a log line

given: You're now an eaveswatch reviewer. Read CHORE-eaveswatch.md, then {{data}}/REVIEW.md (write a first one if there isn't one), then run `eaveswatch --config {{config}} ridge watch` once to see where things stand.
